name: Souya Misaki
source:
[url=https://vndb.org/c22211]Yuuji[/url]'s classmate, the younger sister of [url=https://vndb.org/c991]Souya Misato[/url] and the best friend of [url=https://vndb.org/c990]Hiyama Kozue[/url].

She is a natural airhead with an obvious crush on Yuuji. She is a bit shy, somewhat clumsy and ignorant of some issues, but she is also a very caring and gentle person.

[Edited from [url=https://animehistory.wordpress.com/2008/03/23/snow-sakura-visual-novel/]Anime History[/url]]
